activation.reason: The archived single-step SET positive-control premise is unsupported; when any R9 target remains unlearned, locate the missing visual read/write lower bound before another recurrent-memory change.

shared_contract.choice_views: four forward-cyclic training views, exactly 32 exposures each; four disjoint fixed reverse-cyclic evaluation views
shared_contract.evaluation: M0 and fixed endpoint under all four held-out reverse-cyclic views for normal and reset

direct-pixel-oracle.scientific_role: capacity oracle only; not a deployable memory method and never a formal success claim
direct-pixel-oracle.parameterization: one unconstrained 1024x1024 RGB logit tensor; image=sigmoid(logits)

dreamlite-single-set.scientific_role: tests whether the current DreamLite updater can write a visual code once the base task is reduced to one SET
dreamlite-single-set.learning_rate: unchanged R5 640-step prefix: 1e-5 to 3e-5 warmup, then cosine

locked_interpretation.pixel_8_dreamlite_8: The frozen visual channel and one-step DreamLite write are supported. Advance to a shared multi-item F1 train/held-out-dev alignment experiment before recurrence.
locked_interpretation.pixel_8_dreamlite_0_to_7: The Reader/image channel is usable, but DreamLite parameterization, conditioning, or update optimization is the bottleneck. Redesign only the updater side.
locked_interpretation.pixel_1_to_7: Visual-channel learnability is target-dependent. Diagnose fixed option/token/query properties before claiming a general visual code.
locked_interpretation.pixel_0: The current differentiable Reader/loss/preprocessing interface has not demonstrated a readable pixel code. Test a post-resize pixel/token oracle before changing recurrence.
locked_interpretation.technical_failure: Rerun only invalid targets in fresh roots; make no scientific inference from invalid targets.

success_boundary.formal_success_still_requires: shared training, held-out ID/OOD evaluation, multiple seeds, and causal state controls at a fixed endpoint
